viewing_check: Confirm species: sniff for Huon's strong oil scent, look at end grain and colour (Huon is pale yellow, fine, oily; celery-top or myrtle/eucalypt burl differ). Measure length, width and thickness, check how deep the checking and voids go, whether the two halves are one piece, and that the figure runs through the full thickness (not just a surface face). Photograph the back and edges.
